title: GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY labels are 1-based but input is 0-based
description:
In `game_20260309_003722_g1`, Opus Brewer hit two recoverable `GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY` failures because the prompt rendered the only choice as `1. {T}: Create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.` while the bridge simultaneously instructed the model to answer with zero-based indices (`choice=0, choice=1, etc.`). The model followed the visible label and sent `choice="1"`, which the bridge rejected as out of range. This is a renderer/protocol mismatch, not pure model misuse.

Evidence:
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_003722_g1/Opus Brewer_llm.jsonl:105` shows `GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY` for the Presence of Gond token with `choices[0].description = "1. {T}: Create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token."` and `respond_with = "choice=0, choice=1, etc. (not yes/no)"`.
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_003722_g1/Opus Brewer_llm.jsonl:107` shows `choose_action({"choice":"1"})` returning `Index 1 is out of range (valid: 0-0)`.
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_003722_g1/Opus Brewer_llm.jsonl:197` and `:199` repeat the same mismatch and error later in the same game.
- `website/public/games/game_20260309_003722_g1.json` decisions 103 and 171 preserve the same failed `choice:"1"` retries.

Source:
- `Mage.Common/src/main/java/mage/view/AbilityPickerView.java:27-45` prefixes each ability label with `num + ". "`, making the visible text 1-based.
- `Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/BridgeCallbackHandler.java:1220-1236` forwards those labels unchanged while telling MCP clients to respond with zero-based `choice` indices.

Suggested fix: make `GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY` descriptions and accepted indices agree. The smallest fix is to strip numeric prefixes before exporting ability descriptions to MCP; alternatively accept the rendered ordinal if present. Either way, the prompt must stop showing 1-based labels while requiring 0-based input.
